task: Core 1186 U04: fail-closed Pro-only Digital Office route shell while keeping Alap transactional commerce emails

assuranceCeiling.rationale: A plan access denial on a nested Next.js admin route is a consequential tenant entitlement boundary. Enforce it server-side using the existing canonical officeCommunicationAdvanced feature, prove negative Alap and positive Pro and preserve transaction emails; this does not claim backend or full #1186 closure.

acceptanceCriteria: The server-side Digital Office route layout calls requirePlanFeature(officeCommunicationAdvanced) before rendering children or issuing office data queries.
The root admin communications route, email workspace, tasks, chat and linked nested pages inherit the Pro-only layout gate rather than independent client-side hiding.
The Alap catalog retains officeCommunication and support, while the Pro entitlement catalog retains officeCommunicationAdvanced and Team Chat.
The existing older test which claimed Alap access to the shared office UI is corrected to the newer explicit PO package authority; normal transactional emails are explicitly protected.
Covers Alap with manual or trial chat overrides, Pro with valid entitlement and Pro without released advanced feature as fail-closed outcomes.
All Development Guard, Plan Before Code, Edit-Time/Reference and Implementation Sync, Knowledge, Incremental Replay, Release Risk, exact-head CI Truth and Lifecycle finish before merge.
invariants: The canonical Next.js RSC layout and existing requirePlanFeature are the sole new entrypoint authority; no new package flags, copy of permission policy or client-only gate.
No customer email dispatcher, communication job runtime, base officeCommunication grant, support navigation outside the Digital Office route, or SQL changes.
A route-level gate does not automatically protect direct server action or API invocations, and #1186 remains PARTIAL until these are proven.
forbiddenStates: Alap renders the Digital Office shell or shared mailbox despite a manual override and an underlying Pro-only subscription policy.
Pro is blocked from the shared office due to using the base officeCommunication check incorrectly.
Removing Alap officeCommunication or support to hide the workspace and thereby breaking receipts, notifications or customer communication.
A UI-only route gate is reported as complete Digital Office security or full #1186 DONE.

failureModes: Tenant plan stale after downgrade permits a rendered Digital Office shell
Broad layout guard blocks ordinary support outside the office subtree
Client-only hide leaks server-rendered sensitive office data
Manual entitlement grants are mistaken for Pro subscription
Pro feature missing or revoked and route erroneously remains accessible
edgeCases: Alap navigates by deep link directly to nested Office email composer
Pro subscription but officeCommunicationAdvanced feature disabled
Alap override to officeCommunicationAdvanced should be denied by canonical subscription boundary
Staff actor authenticated but outside selected tenant
No tenant selected must fail closed

alternatives.summary: Gate the existing server Digital Office layout with the canonical Pro-only officeCommunicationAdvanced entitlement before rendering subtree.
alternatives.reason: Single existing server entrypoint protects all nested office pages while leaving ordinary Alap commerce and support routes untouched.

alternatives.summary: Hide shared inbox tabs and Digital Office links only in client navigation components.
alternatives.reason: Deep links still render the server data and actions; obscuring navigation is not authorization.

alternatives.summary: Revoke officeCommunication from Alap to implicitly close Digital Office screens.
alternatives.reason: Breaks normal order and transactional customer emails, contradicting the accepted package boundary and existing grant authority.

specialistReviews.finding: Existing canonical Next server requirePlanFeature and feature_entitlement already model the Pro boundary; a single RSC layout gate covers nested page render.
specialistReviews.resolution: Reuse officeCommunicationAdvanced, avoid another registry or migration, and scope the commit to UI route authority.

specialistReviews.finding: A route layout can deny HTML/RSC but cannot prove separately callable server actions and HTTP APIs are secure; claiming #1186 DONE would be unsafe.
specialistReviews.resolution: Mark server action/API checks explicitly outside this unit, block Alap RSC before office data reads, and require subsequent backend units.

specialistReviews.finding: The Next.js server layout executes before nested route rendering and can use an awaited canonical server-only plan guard.
specialistReviews.resolution: Use async root communications layout and await requirePlanFeature before JSX, with unchanged nested UI contract.

specialistReviews.finding: Historical pro-entitlement test explicitly demands the obsolete Alap office workspace view while current Product Owner decision forbids that surface.
specialistReviews.resolution: Correct the outdated UI expectation and assert Alap transactional email grant and dispatcher remain untouched.

challenge.finding: Page could query customer conversations without nav interaction
challenge.resolution: Server layout requires advanced office feature before children

challenge.finding: Nested workspace can be accessed by entering a URL directly
challenge.resolution: Gate the common parent layout to cover nested paths

challenge.scenario: Alap tenant receives a stale positive entitlement override
challenge.finding: The shared-workspace gate could trust stale manual source
challenge.resolution: Canonical entitlement helper enforces actual tenant plan boundary for officeCommunicationAdvanced

challenge.scenario: Pro tenant does not have an active advanced office entitlement
challenge.finding: Subscription alone would incorrectly authorize disabled module
challenge.resolution: Require the released feature entitlement and retain default fail-closed redirect

challenge.scenario: Old Alap officeCommunication grant is removed to hide UI
challenge.finding: Transactional customer messages and support stop working
challenge.resolution: Never modify base plan grant or transaction dispatcher; assert Alap baseline remains

challenge.scenario: Server Action is called without loading the layout
challenge.finding: A route-level gate does not protect direct RPC or server action invocation
challenge.resolution: Keep backend proof explicitly separate and issue #1186 PARTIAL

challenge.finding: Alap baseline customer service entrypoint becomes inaccessible

challenge.scenario: Pro page loses existing functional navigation after authorization
challenge.finding: Redirect applied unconditionally or to the wrong feature
challenge.resolution: Gate using officeCommunicationAdvanced only and retain child rendering structure

proofPlan: Run critical Development Guard and Plan Before Code on exact known main baseline, reviewing all generated semantic route authority and impacted pages.
Negative contract tests require the parent Digital Office layout server to call requirePlanFeature with advanced entitlement, and old Alap shared workspace assertion to be absent.
Positive contract tests preserve Alap officeCommunication and support entitlements and existing transactional delivery references.
Run targeted regressions and TS check, then Edit-Time Reference and Implementation Sync, Knowledge/Deep Atlas, Incremental Replay and release risk.
Run exact-head GitHub CI and Truth/Lifecycle closure; do not merge until exact completed proof and follow with main CI.

semanticExecutionRoute.request: Core 1186 U04: fail-closed Pro-only Digital Office route shell while keeping Alap transactional commerce emails

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: The Alap officeCommunication entitlement is necessary for ordinary customer commerce email, but the Digital Office route shell currently permits an Alap customer to enter shared mail, staff tasks and other Pro-only workforce surfaces.
observableOutcomes: Direct navigation to any page under the Digital Office /admin/kommunikacio subtree rejects an Alap tenant using the existing server authoritative subscription entitlement, before any page queries run.
Pro tenants with the released officeCommunicationAdvanced entitlement retain their existing Digital Office navigation, pages and behaviors without new duplicate access systems.
Alap normal transaction emails, order notifications, ordinary marketing/newsletters, and support accessible outside the Digital Office subtree continue working unchanged.
unresolvedRisks: Directly invoked server actions and API handlers do not inherit RSC layout access; they must remain PARTIAL and be separately tested in later bounded release units.
The shared officeCommunication baseline grants remain necessary for transactional email; tenant plan switches and manual override proof require separate downstream authorization closure.

in: Digital Office route shell server-side admission and its direct negative/positive regression tests
Update legacy test expectations from Alap shared office UI to Pro-only office UI with ordinary transactional Alap email preservation
out: Any Builder or Template Factory work

requirements.requirement: Any direct Digital Office nested page render is Pro-only under server authoritative advanced office entitlement, including Alap negative and Pro positive cases.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Alap may not render full Digital Office via direct nested route.

requirements.requirement: Ordinary customer-facing transactional emails and support remain part of Alap independent of Digital Office route access.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Alap officeCommunication and support plan grants and order email dispatch must not be removed.

notes: Complete the assurance ceiling, DEFINE/MODEL/PLAN/CHALLENGE evidence, specialist reviews and PO-derived Completion Contract. Only then set status to ready-for-implementation and executionAuthorized to true before running Plan Before Code.
